AUTHOR: Shah
TITLE: YOLOv8-TF: Transformer-Enhanced YOLOv8 for Underwater Fish Species Recognition with Class Imbalance Handling
REGION: Gulf of Mexico, USA (SEAMAPD21 reef fish survey)
SPECIES: 130 reef fish classes in SEAMAPD21 (121 evaluated), e.g. Lutjanus campechanus, Epinephelus morio, Balistes capriscus, Seriola dumerili, Calamus spp.
DATA: SEAMAPD21 public dataset (28,319 images); also Pascal VOC and MS COCO for generic benchmarking
V_EV: no statement found (turbidity and lighting appear only as generic challenges in Abstract/Introduction; Sec. 3.3 notes 'low-resolution underwater environments' without any measurement)
D_EV: Sec. 3.3: 'For the experimental setup, a train-validation-test split ratio of 70/15/15 is utilized. The mean average precision (mAP) is then evaluated on the test set'
R_EV: Sec. 6: 'experiments conducted on the Southeast Area Monitoring and Assessment Program Dataset 2021 (SEAMAPD21)' (single fish dataset; VOC/COCO are separate non-fish benchmarks)
C_EV: no statement found (only mAP0.5 and mAP0.5:0.95 reported; Fig. 10 caption 'High confidence is exhibited' is qualitative)
E_EV: Sec. 4.2: 'the commonly used metric mean average precision (mAP) is employed' (detection metrics only; counting is future work in Sec. 6)
ARCH: YOLOv8-TF: YOLOv8 with doubled C2f depth scale, transformer blocks in backbone and neck, class-aware loss (eta = 8) and Wise-IoU v3 loss; trained from scratch
METR: mAP0.5 87.9%, mAP0.5:0.95 61.2% (121 species), per-species AP (Table A1), params, GFLOPS, inference FPS; ablation
NOTE: D1 ambiguous: paper states only a 70/15/15 train/val/test split of SEAMAPD21 images without saying whether it is the dataset's predefined split (SEAMAPD21 = predefined by image) or the authors' own random split; coded as image-level split (D_ALL = N). If verifier treats it as the predefined public split, D1 = 사전 정의 공개 split 사용 and D_ALL = P. Species with < 10 samples dropped (121 of 130 evaluated). Source code 'will be made publicly available' at a named GitHub repo (coded CODE = Y). Inference FPS reported (116) but video frame rate not; FPS field = NR. No confidence threshold, calibration or false-positive analysis. Table 1 text inconsistency: parameters quoted as 51.08 M in text vs 30.56 M in table.
